paper.title_en: One-loop Corrected Holographic Shear Viscosity to Entropy Density Ratio at Low Temperatures
paper.abstract_en: Near-extremal black holes contain infrared-enhanced quantum fluctuations in their near-horizon near-AdS$_2$ throat, governed in part by Schwarzian modes. We study the effect of these fluctuations on the zero-frequency stress-tensor response of a near-extremal asymptotically AdS$_4$ Reissner--Nordström black brane whose transverse directions are regulated by a finite toroidal quotient. Working directly in four dimensions, we compute the leading correction in the weakly coupled Schwarzian regime $T_q\ll T\ll r_0/L^2$. At one loop, the shear perturbation couples to the $n=2$ would-be zero mode and produces a correction proportional to $T_q/T$. Together with the logarithmic correction to the entropy, this yields a finite-volume correction to $η/s$. Our calculation provides a direct four-dimensional benchmark, complementary to exact two-dimensional treatments, while keeping the asymptotic AdS$_4$ source explicit.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在四维渐近AdS4 Reissner–Nordström黑膜背景下，直接在四维中计算一圈修正下的剪切黏度与熵密度比η/s，涉及近极端黑洞、Schwarzian模与近AdS2喉部红外增强量子涨落，属于黑洞热力学与全息对偶交叉的核心理论问题；其显式四维基准计算与二维精确处理互补，理论深度与潜在参考价值较高，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 低温下全息剪切黏度与熵密度比的一圈修正
decision.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞在其近视界的近AdS$_2$喉部包含红外增强的量子涨落，这部分受到Schwarzian模的支配。我们研究了这些涨落对近极端渐近AdS$_4$ Reissner--Nordström黑膜零频应力张量响应的影响，该黑膜的横向方向由有限环面商加以调控。我们直接在四维中工作，计算了弱耦合Schwarzian区域$T_q\ll T\ll r_0/L^2$中的领头阶修正。在一圈阶，剪切扰动与$n=2$的准零模耦合，并产生一个正比于$T_q/T$的修正。结合熵的对数修正，这给出了对$η/s$的有限体积修正。我们的计算提供了一个直接的四维基准，与精确的二维处理互补，同时保持渐近AdS$_4$源显式可见。
